title: OrderChange - Order Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the OrderChange data model. It belongs to the Order Module.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the order change.

types.name: return_id
types.description: The ID of the return that's making this order change.

types.name: claim_id
types.description: The ID of the claim that's making this order change.

types.name: exchange_id
types.description: The ID of the exchange that's making this order change.

types.name: version
types.description: The version that the order change belongs to.

types.name: change_type
types.description: The type of change made.

types.name: description
types.description: The description of the order change

types.name: status
types.description: The status of the order change

types.name: internal_note
types.description: The internal note of the order change, viewed by admin users only.

types.name: created_by
types.description: The ID of the user that created the order change.

types.name: requested_by
types.description: The ID of the user that requested the order change.

types.name: requested_at
types.description: The date that the change was requested.

types.name: confirmed_by
types.description: The ID of the user that confirmed the order change

types.name: confirmed_at
types.description: The date that the change was confirmed

types.name: declined_by
types.description: The ID of the user that declined the order change

types.name: declined_reason
types.description: The reason that the order change was declined

types.name: metadata
types.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

types.name: declined_at
types.description: The date that the change was declined

types.name: canceled_by
types.description: The ID of the user that canceled the order change

types.name: canceled_at
types.description: The date that the change was canceled

types.name: carry_over_promotions
types.description:
Whether the order change carries over promotions from the parent order.

@since v2.12.0
